FIELDS.NAME: Elegant Blinds & Window Treatments
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Inspection Coordinator, Elegant Blinds & Window Treatments, (555) 123-4567, johndoe@elegantblinds.com
FIELDS.GL CODE: Residential and Light Commercial Window Treatment Installation
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Blinds & Window Treatments specializes in providing high-quality window treatments and blinds for both residential and light commercial spaces. Our core operations include the design, retail, and professional installation of a wide variety of window coverings, ensuring that all installations are carried out by trained and certified personnel. We pride ourselves on our commitment to safety and quality, adhering strictly to industry standards and offering comprehensive documentation of our subcontractor credentials. While we provide some integration with home automation systems, all electrical work is performed by certified electricians to mitigate risks. To protect our inventory, we utilize Installation Floater coverage during transit. Our focus is on maintaining a premium customer experience through excellent service and efficient operations, while staying compliant with necessary regulations and qualifications.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/10/2023, a delivery vehicle accidentally dropped a shipment of blinds causing damage to the product with an estimated loss of $1,500. Status: Claim submitted and pending review. On 08/15/2023, a minor installation mishap resulted in damage to customer property estimated at $2,000. Status: Claim approved and payment made.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installation Floater coverage for window treatments and blinds while in transit.
